title: Linux Systems, Kernel Isolation & Node Hardening
summary: Master Linux kernel namespaces, cgroups v2 resource limits, systemd service management, sysctl networking parameters, and worker node diagnostics.
learningObjectives: Configure Linux kernel sysctl networking parameters required for Kubernetes packet forwarding and bridge netfilter.
Diagnose running processes, memory utilization, listening TCP sockets, and systemd units on cloud-native Linux nodes.
Provision node-level kernel tuning ConfigMaps and DaemonSets for production Kubernetes worker fleets.

curriculumModules.title: Kernel Namespaces, Cgroups v2 & Systemd Lifecycle
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Containers are regular Linux processes isolated by 6 kernel namespaces (pid, net, mnt, uts, ipc, user) and governed by cgroups v2 hierarchies managed via systemd slices.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Place kubelet and containerd in dedicated systemd resource slices (system.slice / kubelet.slice) with --kube-reserved and --system-reserved CPU/memory protections so application bursts never starve node daemons.

curriculumModules.title: Linux Kernel Sysctl Tuning & Socket Diagnostics
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: Kubernetes CNI plugins require net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 and high ephemeral port/conntrack limits to route Pod-to-Pod and Service VIP traffic without packet drops.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Enforce sysctl parameters declaratively via node initialization ConfigMaps and privileged node-tuning DaemonSets across all worker pools.

labs.title: Linux Node Diagnostics & Kubelet Systemd Hardening
labs.scenario: A new bare-metal worker node is joining the production cluster. You must verify active systemd units and deploy a node-sysctl ConfigMap in kube-system to persist kernel forwarding parameters.
labs.productionContext: Every production Kubernetes node requires verified kubelet systemd state and persisted sysctl kernel parameters before scheduling workloads.
objectives: Inspect the kubelet systemd unit status using systemctl
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: node-sysctl-config
  namespace: kube-system
data:
  ip_forward: "1"
  max_user_watches: "524288"

steps.title: Verify Kubelet Systemd Daemon
steps.instruction: Check the health of the kubelet systemd service on the control plane node.

steps.title: Provision Kernel Sysctl ConfigMap
steps.instruction: Create the node-sysctl-config ConfigMap in the kube-system namespace with ip_forward=1.

validationRules.remediation: Run `systemctl status kubelet` in the terminal.

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Ensure the ConfigMap is created in the `kube-system` namespace (`-n kube-system`) and contains key `ip_forward` set to `1`.

labs.title: Kernel Socket Auditing & Node Exporter Daemon Deployment
labs.scenario: Security and SRE teams require visibility into listening kernel sockets and host-level hardware metrics in the monitoring namespace.
labs.productionContext: Auditing listening sockets (`ss`) and running a node-exporter workload ensures kernel-level network and CPU saturation anomalies are caught early.
objectives: Audit listening TCP sockets on the host using ss
Deploy the node-exporter workload in the monitoring namespace
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: node-exporter
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-exporter
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: node-exporter
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: node-exporter
          image: prom/node-exporter:v1.8.2

steps.title: Audit Listening Kernel Sockets
steps.instruction: Run `ss -tulpn` to inspect listening TCP sockets and owning kernel processes.

steps.title: Deploy Node Exporter
steps.instruction: Create the `node-exporter` deployment in the `monitoring` namespace with image `prom/node-exporter:v1.8.2`.

validationRules.description: Deployment monitoring/node-exporter is Running with 2 replicas
validationRules.name: node-exporter

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Verify that `node-exporter` is deployed in the `monitoring` namespace (`-n monitoring`) with at least 2 replicas.

assessmentQuestions.question: Which Linux kernel mechanism enforces CPU, memory, and I/O resource ceilings on container processes?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Linux cgroups v2 account for and throttle CPU, memory, block I/O, and PID consumption per process hierarchy, whereas namespaces provide visibility isolation.

assessmentQuestions.question: Which sysctl kernel setting must be set to 1 on Linux worker nodes so pods can route packets across network interfaces?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 enables IPv4 packet forwarding between virtual ethernet pairs (veth), bridges, and physical NICs.
